doc.aIResponseFeedback_prop_onFeedback: Called when user clicks a feedback button. Passes null when deselected.

Maximum visible height before the block becomes scrollable.
Pass a CSS value (e.g. "300px") or a number of lines (e.g. 20).
When set, an expand/collapse toggle is shown.

doc.modelSelector_prop_showPricing: Whether to show pricing metadata in the dropdown
doc.promptInput_prop_fullWidth: Whether the input should take up the full width of its container

doc.promptInput_prop_maxRows: Maximum number of rows to show before scrolling

doc.promptInput_prop_onSubmit: Callback when user submits (Enter or button click)

doc.terminal_prop_title: Window title shown in header bar

doc.threadList_prop_threads: Conversations to display, ordered newest first

Normalized amplitude values (0–1) per slot.
When omitted, a looping idle animation plays.
For bars: one value per bar. For waveform: time-domain samples.
